title: Representative-normalized derived point comparisons
statement: For a field $k$, a commutative ring sheaf $B$ on the small pro-etale site of $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and normalized tensor data $T$ [def-sf-point-evaluation-tensor-data], assume exactness of $\Gamma_s$ and fix derived localizations. Define derived compatibility by: each total left-derived presentation of $\Gamma_s$ is isomorphic to termwise exact sections with the specified localization comparison, and for every pair of derived tensor presentations with resolving representative comparisons there is a unique natural tensor comparison satisfying the representative square obtained by localizing $T.b$ and conjugating the two evaluation localization comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For $a:B\to B\prime$ and scalar data $S$ [def-sf-point-evaluation-scalar-data], define scalar derived compatibility by the unique natural comparison between derived scalar extension followed by exact sections and exact sections followed by ordinary derived scalar extension, normalized on every resolving representative by localization of $S.\kappa$. Include the exact derived sections and its actual localization comparison as aliases of the recorded functor, not independently chosen maps.
